title: Rachel Carson and the Courage to Warn
short_teaser: Rachel Carson documented how pesticides could move through ecosystems and harm wildlife.
story: Rachel Carson documented how pesticides could move through ecosystems and harm wildlife. Her work challenged powerful interests and helped change public understanding of environmental risk. Speaking clearly about a hidden consequence can alter an entire system. A person’s story becomes useful when it helps us recognize choices, courage, persistence, and possibility in our own life. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
